card.name: Numbers just before gram units
card.fires_on: Digits in dose amounts where the next word is likely a gram unit (g, gram, grams, g/dL). Also the letter g inside the word gowns after protective.

modes.label: Digit before gram unit
modes.description: A number in a dose or lab value that is about to be followed by g, grams or g/dL.
modes.example: Trichomoniasis: a single <<2>> g oral dose taken with food.

modes.label: Start of a large mg figure
modes.description: The first digit of a thousand-scale amount such as 1000 mg or 2500 mg.

modes.label: Protective gowns
modes.description: The g starting the word gowns in a list of protective gear.
modes.example: goggles, gloves, and protective<< g>>owns is recommended

card.plain: It notices a dose number that is about to be followed by grams.
